chunks: ‘Ali, and Al-Hasan, and Al-Husayn (peace be upon them) were wearing rings in their left hands.
ai.seo_question: Which hand did the Imams wear their rings on?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the consistent practice of the Ahl al-Bayt in wearing signet rings on their left hands, reinforcing the Prophetic tradition of using the right hand for honorable acts while reserving the left for practical or secondary functions. In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as a key evidence for the permissibility and recommended nature of men wearing rings, particularly those made of silver, as a symbol of authority and identity.
